placements.title: Institutional knowledge can be commanded out of existence
placements.frame: What specific knowledge is being ordered removed or denied from the record, and does the speaker's claimed authority to erase it hold up against what the record otherwise shows?
placements.why: The envelope's three segments form a single thematic arc: an imperative to purge named knowledge (src-1, src-2's rule-of-three enumeration of the spectrograph, its calibration frequency, and the person who did the calibration work) followed by a flat denial that the underlying event ever occurred (src-3), which functions as the stated justification for the erasure. No existing leaf or strata category was available to reuse — EXISTING GRAPH STRUCTURE and EXISTING STRATA are both empty for this repo, so this is the graph's first content. The theme ('authoritative erasure-and-denial of specific institutional knowledge') passes the narrative grain test: it names a recurring subject-type (directives to purge and rewrite a record) that future envelopes could keep feeding, rather than being itself a single fact. src-3's 'never calibrated it' is evidence supporting this same erasure theme (the denial that grounds the purge) rather than a leaf of its own, per the narrative-grain rule against minting leaves for one-time factual assertions. No `under` is set: nothing in the (empty) strata or structure is even loosely adjacent, and the served focus material (ns__Decision_KnowledgeMapping, ns__Actor_XenaGithubber, ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst) is a different, unrelated knowledge-mapping-consulting thread with no mention of the spectrograph, calibration, or an observatory — confirmed absent by pass-2's resolution across all three segments, so there is no legitimate lineage target to attach to.
